rules: resolves(R, S) :- refers(R, K, N), kindScope(K, global), !scoped(R), defines(S, K, N).
resolves(R, S) :- refers(R, K, N), scope(R, O), owns(O, S), defines(S, K, N).
scope(R, O) :- via(R, V, type), resolves(V, X), typeBase(X, T), defines(O, _, T).
scope(R, O) :- via(R, V, Through), resolves(V, X), through(Through, X, O).
resolvable(R) :- refers(R, K, _), kindScope(K, global), !scoped(R).
resolvable(R) :- scope(R, _).
resolvable(R) :- refers(R, K, _), kindScope(K, rules).
problem(R, error, unresolved, '') :- resolvable(R), !resolves(R, _).
problem(R, warning, ambiguous, '') :- resolves(R, S1), resolves(R, S2), S1 < S2.
resolves(R, S) :- refers(R, 'gm.child', N), scope(R, O), owns(O, S), defines(S, _, N), gm.element(S).
gm.local(R, S) :- refers(R, 'gm.variable', N), in(R, D), gm.binder(S, D), defines(S, 'gm.variable', N).
gm.isLocal(R) :- gm.local(R, _).
gm.binderSymbol(S) :- gm.binder(S, _).
resolves(R, S) :- gm.local(R, S).
resolves(R, S) :- refers(R, 'gm.variable', N), !gm.isLocal(R), defines(S, 'gm.variable', N), !gm.binderSymbol(S).
gm.numeric(int).
gm.numeric(number).
gm.typeOfUse(U, T) :- gm.declared(U), resolves(U, S), typeOf(S, T).
gm.typedElement(S) :- gm.element(S), typeOf(S, _).
gm.typeOfUse(U, boolean) :- gm.declared(U), resolves(U, S), gm.element(S), !gm.typedElement(S).
gm.usedAs(N, boolean) :- gm.inferred(U), gm.use(U, bare), gm.useName(U, N).
gm.usedAs(N, boolean) :- gm.inferred(U), gm.use(U, eqBool), gm.useName(U, N).
gm.usedAs(N, number) :- gm.inferred(U), gm.use(U, ordered), gm.useName(U, N).
gm.usedAs(N, number) :- gm.inferred(U), gm.use(U, eqNumber), gm.useName(U, N).
gm.conflict(N) :- gm.usedAs(N, boolean), gm.usedAs(N, number).
gm.typeOfUse(U, T) :- gm.inferred(U), gm.useName(U, N), gm.usedAs(N, T), !gm.conflict(N).
problem(U, error, 'gm.typeConflict', N) :- gm.inferred(U), gm.useName(U, N), gm.conflict(N).
problem(U, error, 'gm.orderOnBoolean', '') :- gm.use(U, ordered), gm.typeOfUse(U, boolean).
problem(U, error, 'gm.boolOnNumber', T) :- gm.use(U, eqBool), gm.typeOfUse(U, T), gm.numeric(T).
problem(U, error, 'gm.numberOnBoolean', '') :- gm.use(U, eqNumber), gm.typeOfUse(U, boolean).
problem(U, error, 'gm.needsBoolean', T) :- gm.use(U, bare), gm.typeOfUse(U, T), gm.numeric(T).
problem(U, warning, 'gm.intWithDecimal', '') :- gm.literal(U, decimal), gm.typeOfUse(U, int).
world.instanceOf(V, C) :- defines(I, 'world.instance', V), owns(C, I).
world.hasInstance(C) :- owns(C, I), defines(I, 'world.instance', _).
resolves(R, I) :- refers(R, 'world.value', N), defines(I, 'world.instance', N).
world.candidate(A, C) :- world.attrValue(A, V), world.instanceOf(V, C).
world.notAll(A, C) :- world.candidate(A, C), world.attrValue(A, V), !world.instanceOf(V, C).
world.ofClass(A, T) :- world.candidate(A, C), !world.notAll(A, C), defines(C, 'world.class', T).
world.classTyped(A) :- world.ofClass(A, _).
world.mixed(A) :- world.valueKind(A, K1), world.valueKind(A, K2), K1 < K2.
world.basic(A, K) :- world.valueKind(A, K), !world.mixed(A), !world.classTyped(A).
typeOf(A, T) :- world.ofClass(A, T).
typeBase(A, T) :- world.ofClass(A, T).
typeOf(A, K) :- world.basic(A, K).
typeBase(A, K) :- world.basic(A, K).
hddl.subtypeOf(T, T) :- defines(T, 'hddl.type', _).
hddl.subtypeOf(T, U) :- hddl.super(T, R), resolves(R, S), hddl.subtypeOf(S, U).
hddl.referenced(S) :- resolves(R, S), !hddl.decomposes(R).
problem(S, warning, 'hddl.unusedTask', '') :- defines(S, 'hddl.task', _), !hddl.referenced(S).
through('mutrose.standsFor', G, H) :- gm.namesTask(G, R), resolves(R, H).
mutrose.bound(T, N) :- mutrose.binding(TR, GV, _), resolves(TR, T), name(GV, N).
problem(P, error, 'mutrose.unboundParam', '') :- mutrose.configured(_), gm.param(T, P), name(P, N), !mutrose.bound(T, N).
mutrose.classOf(X, C) :- typeBase(X, T), defines(C, 'world.class', T).
mutrose.hddlTypeOf(C, H) :- mutrose.typeMap(HR, OR), resolves(OR, C), resolves(HR, H).

problem(HV, error, 'mutrose.paramType', '') :- mutrose.binding(_, GV, HV), resolves(GV, G), mutrose.classOf(G, C), mutrose.hddlTypeOf(C, H), resolves(HV, P), hddl.paramType(P, PR), resolves(PR, PT), !hddl.subtypeOf(H, PT).
problem(R, warning, 'mutrose.noInstances', '') :- gm.selects(R), resolves(R, C), !world.hasInstance(C).
problem(R, warning, 'mutrose.iteratesNoInstances', '') :- gm.iterates(R), resolves(R, V), mutrose.classOf(V, C), !world.hasInstance(C).
